instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: Which verb forms the usual collocation with attention?
questions.explanation: Grab attention is the fixed collocation for something that suddenly attracts notice.
questions.explanation_ar: grab attention هي التلازم الثابت لشيء يجذب الانتباه فجأة.

questions.question: Something that attracts a glance is said to ___.
questions.explanation: Catch the eye is the standard collocation for attracting someone's glance.
questions.explanation_ar: catch the eye هي التلازم القياسي لجذب نظرة أحدهم.

questions.question: Which phrase is the natural collocation for a short glance?
questions.explanation: A quick look is taken, not made or done, so take is the collocating verb.
questions.explanation_ar: quick look يأخذ الفعل take لا make ولا do، فهو الفعل المتلازم.

questions.question: Which verb collocates with pleasure?
questions.explanation: Take pleasure in something is the fixed expression for enjoying it.
questions.explanation_ar: take pleasure in تعبير ثابت يعني الاستمتاع بالشيء.

questions.question: Which verb collocates with mood?
questions.explanation: A mood is created or set, so create collocates with mood.
questions.explanation_ar: المزاج يُخلَق أو يُهيَّأ، فالفعل create هو المتلازم مع mood.

questions.question: Which preposition completes the phrase about goods for sale?
questions.explanation: Goods available for sale are on the market, a fixed prepositional phrase.
questions.explanation_ar: البضائع المعروضة للبيع تكون on the market، وهو تركيب ثابت.

questions.question: Which phrase means gradually as years pass?
questions.explanation: Over time means gradually during a period, while on time means punctually.
questions.explanation_ar: over time تعني تدريجياً خلال فترة، أما on time فتعني في الموعد.

questions.question: Which phrase means one at each moment, not together?
questions.explanation: The fixed phrase is one at a time, meaning separately and in order.
questions.explanation_ar: العبارة الثابتة هي one at a time، أي واحداً بعد واحد.

questions.question: Which phrase means inside her area of expertise?
questions.explanation: Field takes in when it means a branch of study or work.
questions.explanation_ar: كلمة field تأخذ in عندما تعني مجال الدراسة أو العمل.

questions.question: Which adjective goes with rules in this context?
options: the society rules of a group
the social rules of a group now
the sociable rules of a group
the socialist rules of a group
options_en: the society rules of a group
the social rules of a group now
the sociable rules of a group
the socialist rules of a group
questions.explanation: Social rules are the unwritten rules of behaviour in a society.
questions.explanation_ar: social rules هي القواعد غير المكتوبة للسلوك في المجتمع.

questions.question: Which phrase refers to a period long ago?
options: the past days of the town
the former days of the town
the old days of that town
the ancient days of the town
options_en: the past days of the town
the former days of the town
the old days of that town
the ancient days of the town
questions.explanation: The old days is the idiomatic phrase for a time in the past.
questions.explanation_ar: the old days هي العبارة الاصطلاحية للزمن الماضي.

questions.question: Which phrase means the complete account of what happened?
questions.explanation: The full story is the established collocation for the complete account.
questions.explanation_ar: the full story هي التلازم المستقر للمعنى الكامل للقصة.
